title: German Potato Fritters
description: A traditional German side dish made with grated potatoes, onions, and eggs. These fritters are crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the grated potato, chopped onion, and beaten egg.
2. Add the flour to the bowl and mix until just combined.
3. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the potato mixture into the oil.
5. Flatten the mixture slightly with a spatula and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the German potato fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
